chapter.verse: A kha sagihna hong cin’ ciangin Israel mite amau’ khuapi ciatah teeng khin uh ahih manin, khe khat khai bangin Jerusalem ah amaute hong kituah diam uh hi.

Tua ciangin Jozadak’ tapa Jeshua leh a siampi pihte, leh Shealtiel’ tapa Zerubbabel leh a behte hong kipan uh a, Pasian’ mi Moses’ thukham sungah a kigelh bangin meihal biaknate piak nadingin Israel Pasian’ biakna tau bawl uh hi.
Amaute in tua gama midang teengte kihta uh ahih manin a mun lui mah-ah biakna tau phut pahin zing leh nitak simin Topa tungah meihal biakna pia uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in a kikipsaksa bangin buk pawi bawl uh a, ni simin zat dingin a kisehsa zah bangin meihal biakna ni simin pia uh hi;
tua ciangin hihte banah a tawntunga meihal biakna, khadet sim-a biakna leh Topa ’ pawi a kisehsa hun khempeuh leh Topa ’ tungah amau’ ut thu tawh a pia mite khempeuh’ piaknate zong pia uh hi.
Topa’ biakinn a bulpi a kiphuh nai loh hangin a kha sagihna a ni masa ni-a kipanin amaute in Topa tungah meihal biaknate piak ding kipan uh hi.

Tua hi a, amaute in suangseekte leh khutsiamte tungah sum pia uh a, Persia kumpipa Sairas’ tung panin a thu ngahna bangun Lebanon mualtung gam panin tuipi gei Joppa khua ah taamtaak singte a hong puaksuk ding Sidon khuamite leh Tai-ar khuamite tungah zong annek tuidawn leh sathau a pia uh hi.

Amaute, Jerusalem a, Pasian’ innah hong ciahkik uh a kum nihna, tua kum a kha nihna sungin Shealtiel’ tapa Zerubbabel leh Jozadak’ tapa Jeshua in nasep kipan uh a, ama Israel mipihte, siampite leh Levi mite leh salsuahna panin Jerusalem ah a hong ciahkik mite khempeuh in huh uh hi. Amaute in Levi mite kum sawmnih panin a tungsiah peuhmah Topa ’ inn sungah biakna nasepte a vaan dingin seh uh hi.
Jeshua a tapate leh a behte tawh, Kadmiel, Binnui, leh Hodaviahte in Henadad’ tapate leh Levi mi a tapate uh leh a behte uh tawh Pasian’ innah nasemte tungah ukna tavuan la khawm uh hi.

Innlamte in Topa ’ biakinn a bul a phuh uh ciangin, Israel kumpipa David in a geel kholhsa bangin Topa a phat dingin siampite in a puan uh silhin peengkul tawh, Asaf tapa Levi mite in daltuah tawh a panmun ding uhah hong pang uh hi;

tua ciangin amaute in Topa phatna leh lungdam kohna a kidawngin sa uh a, “ Topa tungah lungdam koh ding hoih hi, bang hang hiam cih leh Israelte hong itna kip tawntung hi,” a ci uh hi. Topa ’ inn bulpi kiphut khin ahih manin mi khempeuh in nakpi takin Topa phat uh hi.

Mi dang tampi in a aw neih zah-un lungdamin a kiko uh hangin a inn masa a mu ngeisa siampite leh Levi mite leh innkuan lutang, midang tampite in hih inn bulpi a kiphuh a muh uh ciangin kap-in thuum uh hi.
Mite nakpi takin kiko ahih manin lungdamna awging leh kahna leh thuumna awgingte mite in khen thei lo uh hi; gamlapi pek panin tua awging kiza hi.
